items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: the negro band played the Joanne Skelly outgoing party.

ctx.x: No, this was the Tulsa Club. Very exclusive.

And so later on, I didn't know really how much it counted, but they had two firsts--I think about five years later, like they have what happened on this date in such and such a town--and they had it in there, they weren't saying black then, it was colored or negro, for the first time the Tulsa Club used a negro band for a week and the negro band played the Joanne Skelly outgoing party.
